decisions.why: Examples mix wheelchair accessories (mobility bag, extra-wide lap belt) with walking-aid accessories (cane tips, walking frame net bag), so the division genuinely spans both categories.
Examples are generic polythene/non-sterile disposable gloves rather than nitrile/vinyl/latex exam-grade gloves, best captured as general PPE.
Examples are dishwasher rinse aid products (Greyland, BioHygiene), a cleaning chemical.
Examples are washing-up liquid cleaning products (Greyland, BioHygiene, Mr Kleen).
Examples are safety goggles and heavy-duty rubber gloves used as general protective equipment, not clinical exam gloves.
Examples are patient shampoo caps and rinse-free/towel-off shampoo, i.e. personal hygiene products.
Examples are dishwasher salt cleaning consumables (Finish brand).

Sole example is an Ambu SPUR II resuscitator mask, a manual respiratory support accessory.
